findings.suggested_fix: Change TP-9 so it checks that typing a 301st character is refused exactly as on the page today (maxLength 300). If truncating a long state value is wanted, add it to the design first.

rubric_items.reason: All 26 ACs across S-1..S-6 map to at least one TP. Two mappings are weak: TP-9 tests truncation where AC5 says 'rejects', and TP-10 is mapped to S-6/AC3.
Page checks are unit and route checks are integration, with no e2e. TP-21 is labelled integration in the frontmatter but 'integration plus unit' in the body, because its page part is unit.
Has a 404 negative for EP-1 (TP-15), a 301-char boundary (TP-9), a non-text navigation-state negative (TP-10) and both Inactive status values. TP-9's boundary behaviour drifts from the AC.
Tools match the strategy (Vitest/Supertest/PG16, Vitest/jsdom/Testing Library). No test folders or files are named, and the titles do not carry the requirement-ID prefix that the strategy requires.
Titles are concrete and runnable. There is a small level inconsistency on TP-21, and some 'reuse' entries do not show the asserted message.
